flow_summary: The interviewer repeatedly responded to the confused patient's requests for clarification or partial/vague answers with terse commands such as 'Please repeat your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format,' 'Please answer yes or no,' or 'Please repeat your 10-digit phone number' rather than breaking questions down or guiding. Full address was abandoned after the patient's confusion; several vague or uncertain replies were not pursued. Safety disclosures received no acknowledgement and the flow remained mechanical throughout.
